summary: Job results, guards and the daily reconcile are easier to read at a glance.

fixes.title: Jobs show ok when nothing changed
fixes.text: A job that ran now shows a green ok even when it had nothing to change, instead of a yellow label that read like a warning.

fixes.title: The Guards panel clears itself
fixes.text: It shows only guards that tripped in the last two hours. Older ones fold away, and there is nothing to acknowledge.

fixes.title: Daily reconcile in plain words
fixes.text: The card says what it does, what the last run did, and that access PIM Manager did not create is left alone.

fixes.title: Mail setup without a certificate
fixes.text: Creating the notification mailbox can now run as the signed-in account or as Invardia support.
